exact_missing_items: Contracts_V0.md has no route-target contract — the canonical shape that all navigation/subject-open commands and surface pivots must conform to
Add a concrete route_target contract to Contracts_V0.md with minimum required fields and a normalization rule for surface-specific IDs
Contracts_V0.md must define the concrete OpenSubject shape — the contract for identity-native object opens that are distinct from workspace-file path operations
UICommand.args for navigation commands must reference the canonical route_target shape rather than ad hoc per-command field lists
UI_Command_Catalog.md must introduce a cmd.nav.* command family that provides canonical wrapper functions for all navigation and subject-open operations

The family should include at minimum: cmd.nav.open_subject (routes through OpenSubject contract), cmd.nav.focus_route (routes through route_target contract), cmd.nav.open_file (workspace path operation, delegates to FileManager contract)
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Concrete Plans/** document requires content reconciliation vs transfer obligation.
